speaker: Doctor
text: I notice you have an enlarged supraclavicular lymph node along with significant weight loss and night sweats. Can you describe the nature of your abdominal pain and its specific location? Also, have you experienced any changes in your bowel habits or noticed blood in your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any history of tuberculosis exposure or recent travel to endemic areas? Also, have you noticed any swelling in your groin or armpits, or any skin rashes?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Is the lymph node in your neck hard and immovable, and have you experienced any painless swelling in other areas like your armpits or groin? I would like to order a biopsy of the enlarged node and a CT scan of your chest, abdomen, and pelvis to evaluate for lymphoma.
